**#814 PR2 — gentle-ai inhabits the port, the Adversary is served from it, n=2 is measured**

PR2 of the ruled 3-PR chain for #814 (chain approved 02/09: PR1=#823 config verb, PR2 closes #814, PR3=#824 discovery). Four units, strict TDD, one commit each, in worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-814.

U1 (04c3b5a): instructions joins the role contract — non-empty string or CHECKED null (mirrors model_tier: null); empty string refused ('no prompt' already has a spelling); plain declares null everywhere.
U2 (bd9b86e): gentle-ai.roles.mjs — the adapter as RECORDED brain-owned data, provenance {recorded, endpoint: ~/.claude/agents/sdd-*.md + Model Assignments table, date 2026-09-02}; sonnet→balanced, opus→deep; chooses_model:false everywhere (D4); custom stages answered via derivedRole() marked derived:true, never silently recorded.
U3 (5abb056): ROLE_DEBT_TICKET discharged — the Adversary instance moved to roles/first-party/adversary-cold-review.mjs (brain's first first-party role; #576 grows the archetype set around it); git mv cold-review-prompt.mjs → assemble-review-prompt.mjs keeps the derived-from-reader protocol machinery with the role as a refused-if-absent argument; 17 protocol tests moved intact; neutrality (ADR-0019 Am.1 c.2) asserted: no engine/map/model/transport key on the served object.
U4 (e3fe7db): INHABITANTS += gentle-ai; the TRIPWIRE FAILED on the real second entry and was deleted per its own instructions. n=2 measured — the SDD_ENGINE axis is the third port, after VCS and MEMORY.

Verified: 4593 pass / 0 fail; repo:check and nav clean; countable diff 267 (+212 −55) vs lite budget 1000. The tasks forecast said ~740 — git mv turned the deletion into a rename (68-line delta instead of ~290), which is why moving text instead of rewriting it shrinks the REAL diff, not just the reviewer's patience.

Axis vocabulary (D6, maintainer 02/09): engines are FRAMEWORKS (skill+doctrine+hooks), platforms are AGENTS (executing runtimes).
